brief: The canvas displays a retro, stylized representation of a road that scrolls constantly beneath the player's vehicle. The environment features the main path, complemented by simple parallel side roads that run alongside the primary route. As the car moves, the road geometry subtly curves at the far end of the visible path. Randomly positioned, periodic visual obstacles appear along the edges of the road, requiring navigation. The viewer controls the vehicle's direction using arrow keys to steer and uses the space bar to apply the brakes.

statement: This sketch creates a retro-style driving experience with a constantly scrolling road that curves in the distance. The viewer controls a vehicle using arrow keys to steer and spacebar to brake, navigating around randomly positioned obstacles on the road edges. The road features a main path with parallel side roads, and subtle curvature effects at the horizon that give depth to the scene. The implementation uses efficient drawing techniques to maintain performance while creating an engaging visual representation of a moving highway environment.
